# Saloni S. Rajput

> Senior WordPress Developer based in Surat, Gujarat, India, with over four years of professional experience building custom WordPress themes, plugins, WooCommerce stores and authenticated REST APIs.

## Case Studies

- [Tecocraft Performance & SEO Audit](https://salonirajput30.github.io/projects/tecocraft-performance.html): Technical audit and refactor of older client WordPress sites at Tecocraft Infusion Pvt. Ltd.
- [Ikozy WooCommerce](https://salonirajput30.github.io/projects/ikozy-woocommerce.html): WooCommerce store with custom template overrides, product grids and one-page checkout at Narola Infotech.
- [Holger Corporate](https://salonirajput30.github.io/projects/holger.html): Corporate WordPress website built in Elementor Pro to a responsive design specification.
- [Gemini Business](https://salonirajput30.github.io/projects/gemini-business.html): Elementor business website with animations and on-page SEO improvements.
- [Repair Blogs](https://salonirajput30.github.io/projects/repair-blogs.html): Static HTML to WordPress migration with ACF, custom post types and custom redirection logic.
- [Comestey](https://salonirajput30.github.io/projects/comestey.html): WooCommerce store built with Gutenberg blocks and custom PHP styling.
- [SmartSolar](https://salonirajput30.github.io/projects/smartsolar.html): Static HTML to WordPress migration using ACF and custom post types.
- [SLED (MTheory Group)](https://salonirajput30.github.io/projects/sled-mtheory.html): Elementor website with responsive layouts and smooth page transitions.
- [BreathingCenter](https://salonirajput30.github.io/projects/breathingcenter.html): Static HTML to responsive WordPress migration with ACF and custom post types at Tecocraft.
